name: Chicago, IL
local_rules: The Department of Finance (DOF) handles parking ticket appeals in Chicago. Both online contest and mail-in hearing request options are available. Online portal found at chicago.gov parking ticket payment options page which includes dispute/contest links.

appeal_mail_address.department: City of Chicago Department of Administrative Hearings

verification_metadata.notes: URL is on official .gov domain (chicago.gov) but path contains "payment_options" suggesting payment functionality, not contest/dispute. Cannot confirm from URL structure alone that this page supports contesting.

special_requirements.notes: Online hearing request via chicago.gov/account; mail-in options available through DOF

confirmation_note: Chicago, IL allows 30 days to contest. Mark your calendar — missing this window means you lose the right to appeal. Chicago, IL offers an online dispute portal. You can check the official city site for the most up-to-date contest instructions before mailing.
